text: can you pass bevel to vertex also and when beveling, set it up like how we loop cut, so that i can increase the size of a bevel before confirming it
resolution: Bevel now works on vertices too AND is set up like the loop cut — a live preview you size before confirming. editMesh.ts gains bevelVertex(vi, width): a true corner chamfer (one new vert per incident edge pulled back along that edge, every incident face clips its corner to the two new verts, a cap face fills the ring; needs a real 3+-edge corner, declines a degree-2 tip; per-edge slide clamped so it can't pass the far vert). In Studio.tsx the bevel is no longer instant: a new  preview state ({kind, index, width}) re-lowers the chamfer through the SAME draft path the loop cut uses, so changing the width in the popup updates the model live. The edge-mode 'bevel' button now opens BevelPopup, and vertex mode (1 vertex selected) gets its own 'bevel' button opening the same popup. BevelPopup is a width stepper in modeling units, clamped to bevelMaxUnits (the shortest incident edge x0.45, so the slider maps 1:1), plus Apply/Cancel; Esc cancels. While the popup is open it behaves exactly like the loop cut: a press only orbits (so you can spin to inspect the live chamfer), the transform gizmo + normal handle + size readout hide, and keyboard/picking are gated so nothing fights the popup. Verified: editMesh suite 86/86 (incl. 2 new bevelVertex cases), and the full hmsc-int cart bundles clean (4.9mb).
